rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; f4952 p.3 Line4a includes taxable interest and ordinary dividends in this screened slice. ScheduleB line2 is the sum of interest.amount entries; Form1040 line2b copies that subtotal. ScheduleB line6 supplies the same ordinary-dividend total carried to Form1040 line3b. The alternative references identify the same prepared-return amounts; this does not assert equivalence for independently inconsistent boundary overrides or every unknown/refusal ordering.

Ruling: equivalent within scope; project retained. The project sums Schedule B line 2 (total interest before the excludable savings-bond interest on line 3, which is refused and zero) and Schedule B line 6 (ordinary dividends); the second sums Form 1040 lines 2b and 3b, which are those Schedule B totals carried to Form 1040. Same values within scope (Form 4952 instructions pp. 3–4, line 4a).

Ruling: model error; f4952 p. 3, Line 4a: "Gross income from property held for investment includes income, unless derived in the ordinary course of a trade or business, from interest, ordinary dividends (except Alaska Permanent Fund dividends), annuities, and royalties." The amounts are the project's: Form 1040 line 3b copies Schedule B line 6 (Form 1099-DIV box 1a), and Alaska Permanent Fund dividends are on Schedule 1 line 8g, not Schedule B. No value difference. The candidate attaches f4952.unsupported to line 4a, a screen the project reads only when the form is used. Every completed-return difference is on a return that does not use Form 4952: line 1 $0, no 2024 carryforward and no line 4g election (checked on the recorded completed witnesses with --explain). It follows structurally: when the form is used, the project's line 8 reads line 5 and line 2, which refuse on f4952.unsupported and f4952.alternative_allocation, so a completed project return with that screen unanswered or answered Yes has no investment interest, carryforward or election. On such a return every amount is zero whatever the screens say, and the candidate still asks or refuses on them, an answer the source does not need (the over-refusal PENDING-6 of the credits-misc package removed from the project). Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f4952.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 210 partial records; 2,205 comparisons): 2,068 agree; 103 candidate-unknown, 34 candidate-refuses; on completed returns 20 candidate-unknown, 9 candidate-refuses. Completed witness 2 (classm.f8962.1.deepseek): project $0.00, candidate refuses.

Ruling: model error; the candidate reads f1040.line3a whatever box 1a is above zero, so it needs that answer where the source does not: i1040gi p. 25, Line 3a, "Qualified dividends are also included in the ordinary dividend total required to be shown on line 3b": with box 1a (line 3b) zero, line 3a is zero. The project reads the gate line f1040.line3a_if_ordinary, which takes f1040.line3a when box 1a is above zero holds and zero otherwise; the interview asks f1040.line3a only then (gated_by f1040.line3a_if_ordinary), so on every return the interview can produce with the condition true the two sides agree. Ruled by reading: the scoped reply names interfaces the candidate bank does not resolve, as in the earlier line-scoped passes of this lane.

Ruling: model error; same point as the refresh-round ruling (project line unchanged). f4952 p. 4, Line 4g: "To make the election, enter on line 4g the amount you elect to include in investment income"; p. 3, Who Must File: "you must file Form 4952 to claim a deduction for your investment interest expense. Exception. You don’t have to file Form 4952 if all of the following apply". The reply's filing test is (carryforward, line 1 or line 4g) and (line 4c not above line 1, line 5 positive, or a carryforward); it drops the project's separate line 4g trigger, so a return whose exception holds but which elects on line 4g is false in the reply and true in the project. The election is made only on the form. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; f4952 p. 4, Line 4g: "To make the election, enter on line 4g the amount you elect to include in investment income", and p. 3, Who Must File: "you must file Form 4952 to claim a deduction for your investment interest expense. Exception. You don’t have to file Form 4952 if all of the following apply". The election is made only by an entry on the form, so a return with a line 4g election files Form 4952 even when the exception otherwise holds; the candidate (its note: "I did not encode a 4g election as a separate filing trigger") is false there. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f4952.json`, refresh round; 1,565 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 194 partial records): 2,067 of 2,259 agree; on completed returns 16 value. All six recorded completed witnesses (classm.f1040.2 and .deepseek, classm.f5329.2 and .deepseek, classm.tcw.16: line 4c above line 1, no carryforward; classm.tcw.10: line 1 $0) are line 4g elections, project true, candidate false; structurally a project-true candidate-false difference needs the exception to hold, which leaves only the election branch. The refusals and unknowns elsewhere are the screen pattern of the earlier rounds on records the interview cannot complete. The project's line is unchanged from the backlog round.

The project line5 is zero on its admitted slice and refuses unsupported expenses; the reply tests that screen directly. Both require filing for a positive line4g election under pp.3-4. Ruling: model error; f4952 p.4 Line4g says to make the election by entering the elected amount on line4g. A positive declared election therefore needs this form even if the interest-expense deduction otherwise meets the p.3 filing exception. Both returned predicates omit the positive-line4g condition. For investment interest $100, ordinary nonqualified investment income $200 and declared elected dividends $50, the exception can hold while the election still requires Form4952. The project asks whether the form is needed for the deduction or declared election; no new owner scope choice is made.

The candidate keeps the Stage 20 change (it tests line 3, so a 2024 carryforward alone can require the form; f4952 p. 3, Who Must File: "you must file Form 4952 to claim a deduction for your investment interest expense. Exception. You don't have to file Form 4952 if all of the following apply. ... You don't have any carryover of disallowed investment interest expense from 2024.") but drops the project's disjunct for a positive line 4g, so a filer whose only reason to file is the election is told the form is not required.
